ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, authorized signatories, and UBOs against the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, the Egyptian consolidated terrorist entities and persons list (issued by the Public Prosecutor under the Anti-Terrorism Law No. 94 of 2015), the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals List, EU/UK consolidated sanctions lists, and domestic designations published by the Central Bank of Egypt and the Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (MLTFCU). PEP identification and Enhanced Due Diligence required for Politically Exposed Persons per FATF Recommendation 12 and Article 3-bis of Law No. 80 of 2002, including verification of source of wealth and source of funds.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) One-Stop Shop and unified investor portal (www.gafi.gov.eg) in coordination with the Commercial Registry under Law No. 34 of 1976
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Arabic is the official statutory language; every Egyptian company must have an Arabic company name. A foreign-language (e.g., English) name may be registered in addition and is transliterated phonetically into Arabic. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered name or well-known trademark.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Egypt or Arab Republic of Egypt (requires special GAFI clearance and does not imply state affiliation)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written grievance with the GAFI Investor Grievance Committee within 30 days of the rejection notice, submitting the original name reservation receipt, the rejection letter, and a legal memorandum justifying the proposed name. The Grievance Committee must issue a decision within 15 working days. A further judicial appeal may be lodged with the competent Administrative Court of the Egyptian Council of State (Conseil d'État) within 60 days of the adverse grievance decision. Name reservation may be renewed prior to expiry by paying the prescribed renewal fee at the GAFI One-Stop Shop.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not accepted for statutory registration. GAFI, the Commercial Registry, and the Egyptian Tax Authority require a physical, accessible registered address in Egypt for service of process and tax correspondence. Virtual office arrangements may be used only for administrative communications and cannot replace the physical registered office requirement; the manufacturing license, where applicable, further requires an operational industrial site.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-high. Estimated risk of unannounced physical inspection at approximately 40-60% within the first 12 months of operation, driven by the heavy electrical equipment manufacturing scope (ISIC 2710) which attracts verification by GAFI, the Ministry of Trade and Industry, the Industrial Development Authority, and the Egyptian Tax Authority.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018, Articles 21-31 (LLC formation); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations; Civil Code Articles 1-78 (contract of incorporation).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - Companies Registration Department - One-Stop-Shop (Investor Services Center).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Contract of Incorporation (Aqd Al-Taasis) and Articles of Association (Al-Nizam Al-Asasi) together with the official GAFI incorporation application form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: LLC minimum issued and paid-up capital is EGP 50,000 (approximately USD 1,050). The full amount must be deposited into a temporary bank account at a commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Egypt prior to registration, with a notarized bank certificate of deposit submitted to GAFI. No escrow account is required for local LLCs; funds are released to the corporate account upon issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company acknowledges and adopts the subscription of its founding members to 5,000 ordinary shares comprising the initial paid-up capital of EGP 50,000, and that the rights, ratios and obligations of each subscribing member are recorded in the Members' Register and evidenced by the bank capital deposit certificate issued by a licensed Egyptian bank. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the Company adopts the premises located at the Suez Canal Economic Zone Industrial Lot, Suez Governorate, Egypt as its registered office and principal place of business. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the shareholders hereby appoint Mr/Ms Manager as Chief Executive Officer, Mr/Ms Finance Director as Chief Financial Officer, and Mr/Ms Secretary as Corporate Secretary, each vested with authority to complete incorporation filings before GAFI, the Commercial Registry and tax authorities and to execute ancillary instruments.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and E-Gate Account Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Center - electronic portal (isc.gafi.gov.eg)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create an investor e-account on the GAFI One-Stop-Shop platform using the national ID or passport of the founding managers, upload the proposed corporate name in Arabic and English with a statement of activity, and request preliminary name reservation. Approve the generated reservation certificate and download the digital reference number.
required_dossiers: Original passport or national identity cards of founders
Three alternative name proposals
Draft board resolution approving the establishing documents
Specimen signatures of partners or attorneys
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or public-policy conflict, substitute the next available name proposal within 24 hours and re-pay a reduced reservation fee; escalate via the GAFI legal department for an administrative review before filing a formal written objection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Notarization and Legalization of the Contract of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Office (Ministry of Justice) and a licensed attorney or legal advisor
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed Egyptian counsel to draft the Contract of Incorporation and Articles of Association containing the LLC registration details, capital allocation, management structure and object clause referencing ISIC 2710. Convene a pool of founding members to sign the instrument before an official notary. Pay nominal notarization fees and record the notary certification on each counterpart.
required_dossiers: GAFI preliminary name reservation certificate
Certified copies of founders' passports or IDs
Draft Articles of Association with object clause
POA if lawyer or nominee signs on behalf of any partner
Resolution of the founders on capital subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary raises technical objections, revise the Arabic translations and re-submit for a corrected signature; if a partner is non-resident, obtain an apostilled or consular legalized POA from the Egyptian embassy before the notary appointment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of Temporary Bank Account and Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized Contract and name reservation to a commercial bank, complete the corporate account opening application, and transfer or deposit the full EGP 50,000 minimum paid-up capital. Obtain the official bank certificate of deposit naming the LLC and listing the shareholder subscription amounts; the funds are frozen pending registration and released to the corporate account on GAFI certificate issuance.
required_dossiers: Notarized Contract of Incorporation and Articles of Association
Passports or national IDs of signatories
GAFI name reservation certificate
KYC and AML forms completed by the bank
Proof of office address or registered submission
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence for foreign shareholders, provide source-of-funds statements and certified corporate charts; if the certificate contains errors, request the bank to reissue before the GAFI filing deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI Incorporation Application and Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the notarized Contract, the bank capital deposit certificate, and the statutory forms to the GAFI One-Stop-Shop portal. Pay the unified state filing fee in EGP or through the e-fiscal stamp account. Upon review by the registrar, receive the Certificate of Incorporation and the provisional commercial registration number. The certificate must be collected by the appointed manager or a POA holder in person.
required_dossiers: GAFI standard incorporation application form
Notarized Arabic Contract and Articles of Association (certified copy)
Bank capital deposit certificate
Copies of passports or IDs of managers
Company registered address evidence (lease or title deed)
Signed consent letters of the appointed officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a query or a 30-day cure order, deliver supplementary clarifications and revised annexes within the stated window; any refusal may be appealed to the GAFI dispute settlement committee or the competent administrative court within 60 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Enrollment and Tax Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Office (Ministry of Justice) and the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Proceed to the local Commercial Registry in the governorate of the registered office and enroll the LLC in the Commercial Register, submitting the GAFI certificate and lease documentation. Subsequently apply to the ETA for the tax card under Law 91/2005 via the unified tax portal, and obtain the corporate tax identification number (TIN) and VAT certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation from GAFI
Articles of Association and name reservation documents
Valid lease contract with registration
Service address documents
Passports or IDs of all partners and managers
Tax authority application forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Commercial Registry demands a warning board satisfying local zoning, install it and submit photographic evidence; if ETA delays the tax card, escalate via the ETA office director and apply for a provisional withholding-number certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Insurance and Ministry of Manpower Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) and Ministry of Manpower
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the company with the NOSI office serving the registered office district and file the salary-basis forms for each named founder or employee. Obtain the social insurance company number and file a workforce statement with the Ministry of Manpower under Labor Law 12/2003. Issue employment records and the workplace safety notice board to complete employment law compliance.
required_dossiers: GAFI Certificate of Incorporation (copy)
Commercial registry extract
List of shareholders and managers with social insurance data
Salary declaration forms of NOSI
Employment contracts with signing minutes
Lease contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NOSI rejects the remuneration declarations, re-file corrected forms with an amending annexure before the monthly deadline; in case of late-filing penalties, request an administrative waiver based on initial incorporation logistical delay.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: General Authority for Industrial Development (GAID) through its Industrial Licensing Directorate; entities inside the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) license via the SCZone Authority Industrial Licensing Unit.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Licensing Certificate (industrial operating license) under the Industrial Licensing Law No. 15 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations; a permanent operating license is issued for the manufacture of solid-state transformers and ancillary power electrical equipment.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) - Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B facility - registration in the environmental registry and submission of a scoping environmental impact assessment in the form of an Initial Environmental Review (IER). Certain transformer-manufacturing lines may be reclassified as Category B1 requiring a full EIA if hazardous chemicals or dielectric fluids are used in material quantities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to the public sewer must comply with the Executive Regulations of Law 4/1994 and Ministerial Decree 44/2000: pH 6.0-9.5, temperature not exceeding 43 degrees Celsius, BOD not exceeding 60 mg/L, COD not exceeding 80 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 60 mg/L, oil and grease not exceeding 30 mg/L, and metal concentrations per Annex (1). Atmospheric emissions must meet the air quality limits of the Executive Regulations for particulate matter, SO2, NOx and volatile organic compounds. Hazardous wastes and spent transformer fluids must be transported and disposed of by licensed hazardous waste contractors only.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the Civil Defense Directorate of the Ministry of Interior after inspection of fire extinguishers, sprinklers and egress paths; structural load clearance certificate by a licensed engineering office attesting to slab loading for transformer production; occupational health and safety clearance from the Ministry of Manpower under Labor Law 12/2003 including emergency plan, ventilation and personal protective equipment.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) under the Egyptian Ministry of Finance; central portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; electronic invoicing platform: https://einvoice.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-owned LLC registers through the General Authority for Investment (GAFI) one-stop shop; obtains commercial register and notarized articles of association, then applies to the local ETA district office for the unified Tax Identification Number (TIN) and Tax Card. If annual taxable supplies exceed EGP 500,000, the LLC must also complete VAT registration with the Central VAT Office. The TIN is issued electronically upon submission of incorporation, legal representative, and premises documentation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists. The LLC may elect a fiscal year subject to ETA approval. VAT grouping is permitted under Article 19 of Law No. 67 of 2016 with ETA authorization. Free-zone and Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) tax incentive elections are available under Law No. 83 of 2002. Egypt has no hybrid mismatch rules; anti-avoidance is governed by Article 39b of Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended by Law No. 67 of 2017 and Presidential Decree No. 587 of 2018
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 aggregate annual taxable turnover from goods and services; registration is mandatory above this threshold and voluntary below it
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: B2B and B2G invoices must be issued electronically through the ETA e-invoicing framework; each invoice is sent to the ETA central clearance system via API or web portal, validated in real time (fiscal identity, digital signature, transactional checks) and returned with a QR code and generated Invoice Reporting Number (IRN). The mandate is enforced in rollout phases; covered taxpayers, including manufacturers of high-voltage electrical equipment, must remain API-integrated and cannot clear tax invoices outside the system. E-receipts are also being phased in for B2C retail supplies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods physically exported outside Egypt under customs supervision qualify for the 0% VAT rate under Article 43 of Law No. 67 of 2016, provided the exporter retains export documentation, exports within the legally prescribed time, and repatriates the foreign exchange proceeds in accordance with Central Bank of Egypt regulations. Services rendered wholly to non-residents and enjoyed outside Egypt may also be zero-rated. Supplies to free zones, bonded warehouses, diplomatic missions, and eligible international organizations can qualify as deemed exports.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Signed Customs Declarations including the Advance Cargo Information Declaration (ACID) and the final Customs Summary Declaration (Bayan)
Original Bill of Lading, or Air Waybill/Master Air Waybill for air freight
ETA-approved electronic export tax invoice with valid QR code and IRN
Inward Remittance Certificate from the Egyptian bank evidencing receipt of foreign currency
Export contract, packing list, and certificate of origin for audit substantiation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA and Customs cross-verify export declarations against bank FX records and shipper data. Improper zero-rating triggers clawback of the 14% VAT plus monthly interest of 2% of the due tax, and fines ranging from 50% to 500% of the tax amount for evasion or falsification. Criminal penalties may apply under the Tax Crimes Law for false export or FX-repatriation documentation. SCZONE licensed entities that rely on export-based incentives may additionally lose free-zone benefits if the zero-rating audit fails.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt maintains a unified, market-determined exchange-rate regime following the March 2024 IMF-supported liberalization. The EGP is fully convertible for current-account transactions, including import settlements, service payments, and dividend/profit repatriation, provided such transactions are executed through CBE-licensed banks with supporting trade or investment documentation. Capital-account flows, including inbound equity and outward repatriation of liquidation proceeds, are transferable under Law No. 72 of 2017 (Investment Law), subject to CBE FX dealing-slip registration and GAFI investment-status verification. Practical impediments include periodic interbank USD liquidity tightness, 5-10 day settlement queues during stress, and stringent AML scrutiny on large foreign-currency transfers. Foreign investors may hold both EGP and foreign-currency accounts; no exchange-control approval is required for trade-related conversion, but each transaction must be evidenced by customs declarations, commercial invoices, and the CBE unified transfer forms.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBE Decree No. 40 of 2016 as amended by the 2024-2025 FX-reform circulars, mandatory export-proceeds conversion ratios have been eliminated; exporters may retain 100% of proceeds in foreign-currency accounts at a licensed Egyptian bank. Nonetheless, proceeds must be repatriated to Egypt within 90 days from the bill-of-lading date for manufactured goods, extendable to 120 days for heavy electrical equipment if documentary proof of extended credit terms is provided. All receipts must be credited to the exporter's CBE-licensed account and matched against customs registrations on the Advance Cargo Information (ACI) platform to obtain VAT zero-rating and export-incentive eligibility. The CBE and the exporter's bank may request the underlying sales contracts, bill of lading, and inspection certificates to verify the transaction.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational EGP and FX Account
Foreign-Currency Current Account / Trade Finance Account
Cross-Border Settlement and FX Hedging Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium. Offshore digital EMIs and foreign payment platforms such as Wise, Payoneer, and Revolut Business are not licensed by the CBE and cannot hold corporate EGP accounts, issue documentary credits, or serve as the receiving channel for export-proceeds repatriation. They may be used only as supplementary collection tools for low-value foreign receivables, subject to conversion delay and temporary hold risks. Onshore Egyptian fintech neobank platforms operate under CBE fintech licensing and remain dependent on sponsor banks; their corporate onboarding features no fully remote KYC for foreign-owned LLCs. Accordingly, the EG_LLC should treat EMIs as non-core treasury infrastructure and route all material capital and trade flows through CBE-licensed commercial banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical presence for standard corporate onboarding. CBE AML/CFT rules under Law No. 80 of 2002, as amended, and the Unified Banking Law (Law No. 194 of 2020) require face-to-face verification of the Ultimate Beneficial Owner and at least one authorized signatory at the opening branch. For foreign-owned EG_LLC entities, the Egyptian General Manager and one board delegate must normally attend in person; remote opening is permitted only for EGP-limited operational accounts with a daily cap and no FX or trade functionality. Capital-escrow, FX, and trade-finance accounts invariably require physical appearance, a notarized corporate mandate, and apostilled shareholder resolutions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex offshore beneficial-ownership chain with non-Egyptian shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled Commercial Registry extracts for each intermediate entity; notarized board and shareholder resolutions authorizing the EG_LLC formation; UBO declaration identifying physical persons above the 25% threshold; passport copies and address proof of UBOs; two years of parent company audited IFRS financial statements; source-of-wealth letter from the remitting foreign bank; and GAFI investment certificate confirming foreign-investment classification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Dual-use concern due to high-voltage transformer and switchgear products supplied to critical grid infrastructure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Product data sheets and ISO 9001/14001 certifications; end-user certificates from utility or industrial purchasers; a no-objection letter from the Egyptian Electric Utility and Consumer Protection Regulatory Agency (EgyptERA); commercial contracts restricted to civilian applications; customs import/export declarations; and the company tax card with VAT registration to demonstrate lawful local activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound equity injection exceeding one million USD in a single tranche
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized capital-subscription agreement; GAFI registration certificate noting subscribed capital; board minutes authorizing the remittance; six months of pre-transfer bank statements from the remitting financial institution; tax identification numbers of the parent and EG_LLC; and a business plan detailing the solid-state transformer production-line capex schedule.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid in-and-out FX flows inconsistent with trade-cycle expectations
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed contract register with matching proforma invoices; transport documents (bills of lading or airway bills); CBE dealing-slip references for each prior movement; annual audited financial statements; and a board-approved treasury policy documenting the dual-currency holding rationale and FX hedging strategy.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity and shareholder loans must be remitted via SWIFT MT103 from the foreign parent's bank to EG_LLC's capital-escrow account at a CBE-licensed Egyptian bank. The MT103 narrative must show the purpose code 'FDI Capital Subscription' and the GAFI investment-registration number. The receiving bank verifies the flow against the GAFI certificate, the notarized board resolution, and the Commercial Registry extract, then issues a CBE inward-transfer dealing slip evidencing the FX entry. USD or EUR tranches may be retained in a foreign-currency account or converted to EGP at the interbank rate. Non-resident shareholder loans exceeding equity are registered with the CBE External Debt Department and tested for thin-capitalization to avoid interest re-characterization.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Procurement of silicon-steel laminations, copper winding wire, relays, and power-electronics components is settled through (i) SWIFT MT103 for open-account and advance payments below the documentary-credit threshold, and (ii) irrevocable Commercial Letters of Credit issued under the EG_LLC trade facility via SWIFT MT700, using sight or usance tenors up to 120 days with a 10% quantity tolerance. Import payments must be matched to the ACI platform registration and customs declaration. Export sales of high-voltage transformers to GCC, African, and EU buyers are received under MT103 or confirmed L/C, with proceeds tracked in the CBE export-monitoring system to secure VAT zero-rating.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable onshore USD/EGP and EUR/EGP forward contracts with tenors up to 12 months, available from CBE-licensed banks and supported by genuine underlying trade invoices
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) between EGP and USD/EUR for term facilities matched to capital-expenditure schedules
Plain-vanilla FX options and zero-cost collars written by large licensed banks against real future receivables or payables
Offshore EGP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not cleared onshore and are disallowed for Egyptian-domiciled treasuries; any NDF access must sit at the foreign parent entity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return together with audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – corporate income tax administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the tax year; for a 31 December year-end no later than 30 April of the following year; electronic filing mandatory.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 1.5% per month on unpaid tax from the due date; additional penalty for failure to file; automatic ETA assessment and attachment of bank accounts if arrears remain for more than 60 days; two consecutive non-filing years may result in suspension of tax clearance and administrative de-registration of the commercial record.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Periodic Value Added Tax (VAT) declaration – monthly filing and annual reconciliation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – VAT administration, electronic portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly declaration within 30 days after the close of each tax month; annual reconciliation with the corporate tax return by 30 April of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Delay penalty and statutory interest assessed on unpaid VAT; habitual defaults may trigger suspension of the taxpayer card, restricted import/export privileges and administrative enforcement against the company's responsible officer.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI) – employer registration office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Monthly contribution statements filed within the statutory window following each month; annual reconciliation completed by 31 January of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly delay surcharges on overdue contributions; persistent arrears expose the responsible manager to seizure of company assets and criminal prosecution for misappropriation of social insurance funds.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Assembly / Partners' Meeting minutes and approval of annual financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate books (registered office minute book) and, on demand, General Authority for Investment (GAFI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Meeting to be convened within 6 months of financial year-end; signed minutes retained at the registered office.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold the annual meeting and to approve financial statements for two consecutive years authorizes GAFI to issue warnings, seek compulsory liquidation or strike the company off the commercial register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and Share Transfer Register confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Unified Economic Register (UER) operated in conjunction with GAFI and the AML Law No. 80 of 2002 enforcement regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation at the ordinary general assembly; each share transfer or beneficial ownership change must be filed within 30 days of occurrence.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate UBO records or late share-transfer updates attract administrative fines, restrictions on GAFI services, loss of incentive status and, in serious cases, financial-crime liability under the AML Law.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Audit is compulsory for every Egyptian limited liability company irrespective of turnover, capital or shareholder composition; the auditor must be a licensed certified public accountant registered with the Egyptian Tax Authority and may not be a director or employee of the company.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), substantively aligned with IFRS; audited EAS-compliant financial statements must be attached to the corporate income tax return and presented to the annual meeting.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under AML Law No. 80 of 2002 and Cabinet Decree No. 1480/2020, the register must identify every ultimate natural person holding or controlling the LLC quotas; any transfer, pledge, or change of control is recorded in the share-transfer ledger and reported to the Unified Economic Register within 30 days; the annual general meeting reconfirms the UBO list and the managers sign and date the updated register.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Share Transfers and quota pledges
Minute Book of general assemblies and board decisions
Statutory accounting books and supporting financial records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 – 3,000 per annum (registered office, corporate secretarial support and GAFI/ETA liaison in Cairo or Alexandria)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – 7,500 per annum for a licensed Egyptian CPA firm; Big-4 or IFRS-consolidated reporting may reach USD 12,000 per annum
